propositions: Structured-output validation and retry orchestration must be unified through a single Pydantic Agent operation with a shared request budget, replacing the split between bespoke retry logic and Pydantic AI.
Retry context must preserve complete request/response history without truncation; failed responses are included only when they fit the budget, otherwise omitted entirely.
Rebar deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal behavior, typed exhaustion, failure artifacts, and model provenance must be preserved across the Pydantic integration.
Usage reporting must emit complete Pydantic run metrics exactly once per successful operation, while fallback and downgrade candidates remain as trace/journal events without competing usage counters.
The bespoke structured-output retry loop must be removed only after compatibility suite, authorized provider cache canaries, and live parity evidence pass.
